sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 20 Cost.
Cost removal effect boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 70 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Envy Collapse (blocks max HP increase effects, increases Ability Power of damage taken by 30, increases cooldown by 30%, and increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[Straight-laced] Takina Inoue or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
